title: Phase 16 External Evaluation & OOD Robustness Plan
objective: Verify botanical generalization and context invariance on genuinely unseen acquisition environments.

suite_1_canopy_illumination_stress.description: Outdoor orchard tree canopy without target fruits across rainy, night, and direct noon illumination.
suite_1_canopy_illumination_stress.expected_behavior: Rejection as negative_background (TNR >= 95%); 0% false acceptance as apple.

suite_2_pathological_foliage_stress.description: Diseased citrus leaves and bark with canker, melanose, and greening lesions.
suite_2_pathological_foliage_stress.expected_behavior: Rejection as negative_background (TNR >= 95%); 0% false acceptance as banana/mango.

suite_3_retail_non_target_produce.description: Exotic non-target retail produce displays in market crates and wire baskets.

suite_4_cross_domain_target_generalizati.description: In-split held-out cross-domain target fruits (FruitNet Guava, FruitNet Banana, FruitNet Apple).
suite_4_cross_domain_target_generalizati.expected_behavior: Balanced target recognition across both studio and market sources (Macro-F1 >= 0.95).
